verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs explicitly claim auto top-up from linked checking accounts with target balance automation and low-balance alerts, directly matching the story. However, this rests solely on first-party marketing copy with no independent/hands-on corroboration or detail on configuration flexibility across multiple accounts. Missing for 10: independent verification of the auto top-up feature working in practice, detail on multi-account routing/yield optimization, and community confirmation of alert reliability.
